claims.quote: Seventy-five thousand tons—dead-weight—rushing through the fog at the rate of fifty feet a second, had hurled itself at an iceberg.
claims.description: A huge 75,000-ton transatlantic liner strikes an iceberg at speed in fog.

claims.quote: The holding-down bolts of twelve boilers and three triple-expansion engines, unintended to hold such weights from a perpendicular flooring, snapped
claims.description: A giant liner with twelve boilers and three engines capsizes, her machinery tearing loose and puncturing the hull.

claims.quote: that the invincible *Titan*, with nearly all of her people, unable to climb vertical floors and ceilings, was beneath the surface of the sea.
claims.description: A supposedly unsinkable liner sinks with nearly all of nearly three thousand people aboard.

claims.quote: Twenty-four boats for three thousand people
claims.description: A liner carries lifeboats for only a small fraction of its passengers, with disastrous results.

claims.quote: Curse them, with their water-tight compartments, and their logging of the lookouts.
claims.description: Reliance on watertight compartments gives false safety to a liner.
